author: Apple
description:
Apple Card is is built into iPhone, and you can apply in as little as a minute. No waiting for a physical credit card, no friction. All it takes is a few taps of your iPhone. You can earn unlimited daily cash back, and use it right away.

Learn more: https://apple.co/4iVNQHr
